# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tool-docs.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

**126 tools** in 20 toolsets: 90 read, 26 write, 10 destructive. The default set (marked ★) has 30 tools: a fresh read-only install shows its **26 read tools**, and the 4 default write tools appear with `SC_MODE=write`. Enable more with `SC_TOOLSETS` or the `sc_enable_toolsets` tool; enable writes with `SC_MODE=write` or `full`.

Parameters marked * are required.

## core

Account, identity, search and deep links

### `sc_list_toolsets` ★

Lists every toolset, how many tools each has and whether it is enabled. Access: read.

### `sc_enable_toolsets` ★

Turns on extra toolsets for the session (sends a tools-changed notification). Access: read.

| Tool | Access | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`sc_whoami`](#sc_whoami) ★ | read | Who am I |
| [`sc_web_links`](#sc_web_links) | read | Web links for records |
| [`sc_api_get`](#sc_api_get) | read | Raw API GET (advanced) |

### `sc_whoami` ★

Shows which Mitti user and organisation the API token belongs to, and the server's safety settings (mode, privacy level, enabled toolsets). Call first if a request fails with a permission error.

Access: read

_No parameters._

### `sc_web_links`

Builds links that open inspections, inspection reports, actions or issues in the Mitti web app. The viewer must be signed in with access to the record.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `items` * | object[] |  |

### `sc_api_get`

Advanced: performs a read-only GET on a documented Mitti API path that no dedicated tool covers (see https://developer.mitti.com/llms.txt). Prefer the dedicated tools; they return smaller, cleaner results. Path must start with a known resource prefix such as /feed/, /inspections/, /tasks/, /assets/.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` * | string | API path, e.g. /feed/site_members |
| `query` | object |  |

### `sc_search_inspections` ★

Searches inspections by template, site, owner, completion and archive status. The period filters on the inspection's last-modified date (modified_at), not the date it was conducted or completed. Returns compact rows with score, owner, web links and completion date.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `template_ids` | string[] | One or more template IDs. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 30 days. |
| `completed` | `true` \| `false` \| `any` | Completion status. Default: any. |
| `archived` | boolean | Only archived inspections (true) or only active ones (default false). |
| `owner_id` | string | User ID (user_...). |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 50, max 100). |
| `page_token` | string | Cursor from a previous call's next_page_token to fetch the next page. |

### `sc_get_inspection` ★

Gets one inspection's header: name, score, started/completed/modified dates, owner, last author, site, template, archive status and duration. For the question-by-question answers use sc_get_inspection_answers.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inspection_id` * | string | Inspection ID (audit_...). |

### `sc_get_inspection_answers` ★

Returns one inspection's answers as flat rows: section path, question label, type, response text or selected options, failed flag, score, notes and media count. Repeated sections keep their grouping through parent_id. Use failed_only to see just the failed items.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inspection_id` * | string | Inspection ID (audit_...). |
| `failed_only` | boolean | Only return items with a failed response. Default: all answered items. |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 100, max 500). |

### `sc_get_inspection_report_link` ★

Returns the inspection's web report link (never expires until deleted) and a mobile deep link (expires about a year after creation). Use when someone needs to open the inspection in a browser or the Mitti app.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inspection_id` * | string | Inspection ID (audit_...). |

### `sc_export_inspection_document`

Generates a PDF or Word report for one inspection. The export can take up to about a minute: this tool waits and retries the same request until the file is ready (bounded at 60 seconds). Returns the download URL, which expires, so download it promptly.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inspection_id` * | string | Inspection ID (audit_...). |
| `format` | `pdf` \| `word` | Document format. Default: pdf. |

### `sc_list_inspection_media`

Lists the photos, videos and files attached to one inspection. Pass a media id plus its token to sc_get_media_url to get a downloadable URL.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inspection_id` * | string | Inspection ID (audit_...). |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 50, max 100). |

### `sc_get_media_url`

Turns a media id plus its token (from sc_list_inspection_media or inspection answers) into a downloadable URL. Signed URLs expire quickly, so download immediately.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `media_id` * | string | Media ID from the inspection's media list. |
| `token` * | string | Per-media access token returned alongside the media ID. |
| `media_type` | `image` \| `video` \| `pdf` \| `word` \| `excel` \| `slides` \| `csv` | File kind. Needed for some downloads, especially video. |
| `filename` | string | Download the file as an attachment with this name. |

### `sc_start_inspection`

Starts a new inspection from a template, optionally assigning it to a site. Returns the new inspection's ID and web link. Find template IDs with sc_list_templates.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `template_id` * | string | Template ID (template_...) to start the inspection from. |
| `site_id` | string | Site ID to assign the inspection to. |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_update_inspection`

Patches one inspection. Pass only the fields to change: owner_id, site_id, and/or simple answers (text, number, checkbox, single datetime, or one question's selected response IDs plus an optional note). Returns which fields changed.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inspection_id` * | string | Inspection ID (audit_...). |
| `owner_id` | string | New owner user ID (user_...). |
| `site_id` | string | New site ID. |
| `answers` | object[] | Simple answer updates (max 50 per call). Find item IDs with sc_get_inspection_answers. |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_complete_inspection`

Marks an inspection complete. All required questions must already be answered. If the template has an approval page the inspection moves to awaiting approval instead of complete.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inspection_id` * | string | Inspection ID (audit_...). |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_clone_inspection`

Copies an inspection, including its answers, into a new incomplete inspection on the same template. Returns the new inspection's ID and link.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inspection_id` * | string | Inspection to copy. |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_share_inspection`

Shares an inspection with users or groups in the same organisation. You need edit or delete access on the inspection. Already-shared entries are left unchanged.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inspection_id` * | string | Inspection ID (audit_...). |
| `shares` * | object[] |  |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_restore_inspection`

Restores an archived inspection back to the active list.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inspection_id` * | string | Inspection ID (audit_...). |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_archive_inspection`

Archives one inspection so it leaves the active list. Reversible with sc_restore_inspection.

Access: **destructive** (two-step)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inspection_id` * | string | Inspection ID (audit_...). |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_delete_inspection`

Permanently deletes one inspection. This cannot be undone.

Access: **destructive** (two-step)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inspection_id` * | string | Inspection ID (audit_...). |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

## templates

Templates and global response sets

| Tool | Access | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`sc_list_templates`](#sc_list_templates) ★ | read | List templates |
| [`sc_get_template`](#sc_get_template) ★ | read | Get template |
| [`sc_list_response_sets`](#sc_list_response_sets) | read | List global response sets |
| [`sc_get_response_set`](#sc_get_response_set) | read | Get global response set |

### `sc_list_templates` ★

Lists inspection templates, optionally matching a name fragment (case-insensitive) and including archived ones. Returns compact rows with modification dates.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Only templates whose name contains this text (case-insensitive). |
| `include_archived` | boolean | Include archived templates. Default: active only. |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 50, max 100). |
| `page_token` | string | Cursor from a previous call's next_page_token to fetch the next page. |

### `sc_get_template` ★

Gets one template's metadata plus a compact question outline (section path, label, type, response options). The outline is capped at 100 questions; response options from shared global sets are referenced by ID.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `template_id` * | string | Template ID (template_...). Use sc_list_templates to find it. |

### `sc_list_response_sets`

Lists the organisation's global (shared) response sets: the reusable Yes/No/Yes-No-N/A option lists templates refer to. Get one set's options with sc_get_response_set.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 50, max 100). |

### `sc_get_response_set`

Gets one global response set with all its response options (labels). Use to interpret the selected options in inspection answers.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `response_set_id` * | string | Response set ID from sc_list_response_sets or a template outline. |

### `sc_restore_template`

Restores an archived template back to the active list.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `template_id` * | string | Archived template ID (template_...) to restore. |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_archive_template`

Archives one template so it leaves the active list. Reversible with sc_restore_template.

Access: **destructive** (two-step)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `template_id` * | string | Template ID (template_...) to archive. |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

Corrective actions: list, create, update status/priority/due/assignees/labels, bulk changes, action types

| Tool | Access | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`sc_list_actions`](#sc_list_actions) ★ | read | List actions |

### `sc_list_actions` ★

Lists corrective actions with filters (status, priority, site, template, inspection, assignee, label, title text, created/due period, overdue). Returns compact rows with assignees, due date, days overdue and a web link, plus counts by status and priority.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum[] | Filter by status. Default: all statuses. |
| `priority` | enum[] |  |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `template_ids` | string[] | One or more template IDs. |
| `inspection_id` | string | Only actions raised from this inspection (audit_...). |
| `assignee_ids` | string[] | Only actions assigned to these user or group IDs. |
| `label_ids` | string[] |  |
| `title_contains` | string | Text that must appear in the action title. |
| `created` | string | Created within this period, e.g. "last 30 days", "2026-Q3". |
| `due` | string | Due within this period, e.g. "this month" or "2026-10-01..2026-10-31". |
| `overdue_only` | boolean | Only open actions whose due date has passed. |
| `sort` | `due` \| `created` \| `modified` \| `priority` | Sort order. Default: newest first. |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 50, max 100). |
| `page_token` | string | Cursor from a previous call's next_page_token to fetch the next page. |

### `sc_get_action` ★

Gets one action in full: description, status, priority, assignees, labels, linked inspection and item, site, asset and custom fields.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `action_id` * | string | Action ID (UUID). |

### `sc_list_action_options`

Returns the valid action statuses and priorities, the organisation's action labels and its action types. Call before filtering by label or creating typed actions.

Access: read

_No parameters._

### `sc_create_action` ★

Creates one corrective action, optionally linked to an inspection (and item), a site and an asset, with assignees, priority, due date and labels. Returns the new action's ID and link.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `title` * | string |  |
| `description` | string |  |
| `priority` | `low` \| `medium` \| `high` |  |
| `due_at` | string | Due date-time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-31T17:00:00+11:00. |
| `site_id` | string |  |
| `assignees` | object[] | Assignees: user IDs (user_...) or group IDs. Find them with sc_search_users / sc_list_groups. |
| `inspection_id` | string | Link to this inspection (audit_...). |
| `inspection_item_id` | string | Link to a specific question in that inspection. |
| `asset_id` | string |  |
| `label_ids` | string[] |  |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log; for new actions it is appended to the description. |

### `sc_update_action` ★

Updates one action. Pass only the fields to change: title, description, status, priority, due_at, site_id, assignees (replaces the list) or label_ids (replaces the list). Returns which fields changed.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `action_id` * | string | Action ID (UUID). |
| `title` | string |  |
| `description` | string |  |
| `status` | `to_do` \| `in_progress` \| `complete` \| `cant_do` |  |
| `priority` | `low` \| `medium` \| `high` |  |
| `due_at` | any | New due date-time (ISO 8601), or null to clear it. |
| `site_id` | string |  |
| `assignees` | object[] | Assignees: user IDs (user_...) or group IDs. Find them with sc_search_users / sc_list_groups. |
| `label_ids` | string[] |  |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log; for new actions it is appended to the description. |

### `sc_create_action_link`

Creates a link that lets someone without a Mitti login view and complete one action (for contractors). Anyone with the link can open it.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `action_id` * | string | Action ID (UUID). |

### `sc_bulk_update_actions`

Changes status, priority, due date and/or assignees on many actions at once, selected either by explicit action_ids or by the same filters as sc_list_actions. Maximum 200 actions per call.

Access: **destructive** (two-step)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `action_ids` | string[] |  |
| `filters` | object | Select actions with sc_list_actions filters instead of IDs. |
| `set` * | object | The changes to apply to every selected action. |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log; for new actions it is appended to the description. |

### `sc_delete_actions`

Permanently deletes up to 100 actions by ID. This cannot be undone from the API.

Access: **destructive** (two-step)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `action_ids` * | string[] |  |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log; for new actions it is appended to the description. |

### `sc_list_issues` ★

Lists issues (incidents) with filters (status, priority, category, site, assignee, created/occurred period). Returns compact rows with category, status, priority, site, dates, assignees and a web link, plus counts by status and category.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum[] | Filter by status. Default: all statuses. |
| `priority` | enum[] | Filter by priority. Default: all priorities. |
| `category_ids` | string[] | Only issues in these categories. Use sc_list_issue_categories to find IDs. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `assignee_ids` | string[] | Only issues assigned to these user IDs. |
| `period` | string | Issues from this period, e.g. "last 30 days", "2026-Q3". Applies to created or occurred date (see period_on). |
| `period_on` | `created` \| `occurred` | Which date period filters on. Default: created. |
| `sort` | `due` \| `created` \| `modified` \| `occurred` | Sort order. Default: newest modified first. |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 50, max 100). |
| `page_token` | string | Cursor from a previous call's next_page_token to fetch the next page. |

### `sc_get_issue` ★

Gets one issue in full: description, status, priority, category, assignees, site, asset, the linked inspection, media, location, and the category questions with their answers.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `issue_id` * | string | Issue ID (UUID). |

### `sc_count_issues`

Counts issues matching the same filters as sc_list_issues, without fetching them. Use it before a broad list to size the result.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum[] | Filter by status. Default: all statuses. |
| `priority` | enum[] | Filter by priority. Default: all priorities. |
| `category_ids` | string[] | Only issues in these categories. Use sc_list_issue_categories to find IDs. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `assignee_ids` | string[] | Only issues assigned to these user IDs. |
| `period` | string | Issues from this period, e.g. "last 30 days", "2026-Q3". Applies to created or occurred date (see period_on). |
| `period_on` | `created` \| `occurred` | Which date period filters on. Default: created. |

### `sc_list_issue_categories`

Lists the organisation's issue categories (ID and name). Call before filtering by category or creating an issue, which needs a category_id.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 100, max 100). |
| `page_token` | string | Cursor from a previous call's next_page_token to fetch the next page. |

### `sc_get_issue_timeline`

Lists the activity timeline of one issue: creation, status/priority/site/category changes, assignee changes and comments, newest last.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `issue_id` * | string | Issue ID (UUID). |

### `sc_get_issue_report`

Returns a download URL for one issue's PDF report (the URL expires) and the issue's app link. To create a public web link, use sc_create_issue_share_link.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `issue_id` * | string | Issue ID (UUID). |

### `sc_create_issue_share_link`

Creates a public web report link for one issue. Anyone holding the link can view the report without signing in, so only create one when the user asks to share it.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `issue_id` * | string | Issue ID (UUID). |

### `sc_create_issue` ★

Creates one issue (incident) with a title, category, description, site, occurred date and asset, then applies priority, due date and assignees. Returns the new issue's ID and link, plus which follow-up fields were applied.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `title` * | string |  |
| `category_id` * | string | Issue category ID. Use sc_list_issue_categories to find it. |
| `description` | string | Description (max 500 characters). |
| `site_id` | string |  |
| `occurred_at` | string | When the issue occurred, ISO 8601. |
| `due_at` | string | Due date-time, ISO 8601. Applied after creation. |
| `priority` | `none` \| `low` \| `medium` \| `high` | Applied after creation. Default: none. |
| `assignees` | object[] | Assignees: user IDs (user_...) or group IDs. Find them with sc_search_users / sc_list_groups. |

### `sc_update_issue` ★

Updates one issue. Pass only the fields to change: title, description, status, priority, due_at, occurred_at, site_id, category_id, asset_id, add_assignees or remove_assignees. Returns which fields changed.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `issue_id` * | string | Issue ID (UUID). |
| `title` | string |  |
| `description` | string |  |
| `status` | `open` \| `resolved` |  |
| `priority` | `none` \| `low` \| `medium` \| `high` |  |
| `due_at` | any | New due date-time (ISO 8601), or null to clear it. |
| `occurred_at` | string |  |
| `site_id` | string |  |
| `category_id` | string |  |
| `asset_id` | string |  |
| `add_assignees` | object[] | Assignees: user IDs (user_...) or group IDs. Find them with sc_search_users / sc_list_groups. |
| `remove_assignees` | object[] | Assignees: user IDs (user_...) or group IDs. Find them with sc_search_users / sc_list_groups. |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log; for new issues it is appended to the description. |

### `sc_comment_on_issue`

Adds a text comment to one issue's timeline. The comment is visible to anyone with access to the issue.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|

### `sc_list_assets`

### `sc_find_asset`

Finds assets without knowing the system ID: either by exact asset code, or by an exact string field value such as a serial number or fleet ID (use sc_list_asset_fields to find field names). Pass code OR field_name plus field_value, not both.

| Parameter | Type | Description |

Lists the organisation's asset fields (ID, name, value type, select options). Call to resolve field IDs before setting field values on an asset.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |

Returns one asset's maintenance plans (program, service status, last/next service, open actions) plus recent service history per plan (latest first). Service history is fetched for up to 5 plans.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `asset_id` * | string | Asset ID (system-generated UUID). |

### `sc_maintenance_status_counts`

Counts assets in each maintenance status (scheduled, due soon, overdue, data missing), optionally filtered by site, program or text. Use for a quick maintenance overview.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |

| `site_id` | string | Only assets assigned to this site. |
| `program_id` | string | Only assets in this maintenance program. |
| `text` | string | Keywords to filter assets. |

### `sc_create_asset`

Creates one asset of an existing type, optionally with a code, site, string field values and a status option. Returns the new asset's ID.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type_id` * | string | Asset type ID. Use sc_list_asset_types to find it. |
| `code` | string | Your own unique identifier for the asset (must be unique per organisation). |
| `site_id` | string | Site to assign the asset to. Use sc_list_sites to find it. |
| `fields` | object[] | String field values to set. Use sc_list_asset_fields to find IDs. |
| `status_option_id` | string | Status option to assign (must belong to the type's status group; at most one). |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_update_asset`

Patches one asset. Pass only the fields to change: code, site_id, field_values (string values, merged not replaced) and/or latitude plus longitude. Returns which groups changed.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `asset_id` * | string | Asset ID (system-generated UUID). |
| `code` | string | New user-defined code. |
| `site_id` | string | Move the asset to this site. |
| `field_values` | object[] | String field values to set (only these change). |
| `latitude` | number | New latitude (requires longitude). |
| `longitude` | number | New longitude (requires latitude). |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_archive_asset`

Archives one asset so it can no longer be selected in inspections. The data is kept and the asset can be restored from the Mitti web app.

Access: **destructive** (two-step)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `asset_id` * | string | Asset ID (system-generated UUID). |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

Returns the site hierarchy as a nested tree. Starts below the given site, or at the top-level sites when omitted. Capped by depth; nodes cut off by the cap are marked truncated.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |

| `name` * | string | Site name (1-250 characters). |
| `parent_id` | string | Parent site ID. Omit to create a top-level site. |
| `level` | `location` \| `area` \| `region` \| `state` \| `country` | Site level (default location). |

## schedules

Inspection schedules and occurrences (missed / late / completed)

| Tool | Access | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`sc_list_schedules`](#sc_list_schedules) ★ | read | List schedules |
| [`sc_get_schedule`](#sc_get_schedule) | read | Get schedule |
| [`sc_list_schedule_occurrences`](#sc_list_schedule_occurrences) | read | List schedule occurrences |
| [`sc_pause_schedule`](#sc_pause_schedule) | **write** | Pause schedule |
| [`sc_resume_schedule`](#sc_resume_schedule) | **write** | Resume schedule |
| [`sc_end_schedule`](#sc_end_schedule) | **destructive** (two-step) | End schedule |

### `sc_list_schedules` ★

Lists inspection schedules from the current Schedules API and, when present, legacy schedule items. Each row is labelled with its source. Rows carry title, template, recurrence in plain English when derivable, assignees, site, status (active/paused/ended) and next due date where the API provides one (legacy items only).

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum[] | Filter by status. Default: all statuses. |
| `template_ids` | string[] | One or more template IDs. |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 50, max 100). |
| `page_token` | string | Cursor from a previous call's next_page_token to fetch the next page. |

### `sc_get_schedule`

Gets one schedule in full: title, status, template, recurrence (raw and in plain English), assigned users and groups, target sites/assets summary and creator.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `schedule_id` * | string | Schedule ID (from sc_list_schedules). |

### `sc_list_schedule_occurrences`

Lists scheduled inspection occurrences due in a period (default last 30 days), with missed / late / completed / upcoming filters. Rows carry the schedule, due window, status, completed inspection ID and assignee. Occurrence status is derived from the API status text and due timestamps (see tool notes).

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 30 days. |
| `status` | enum[] | Only occurrences with these statuses. Default: all. |
| `template_ids` | string[] | One or more template IDs. |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 50, max 500). |
| `page_token` | string | Cursor from a previous call's next_page_token to fetch the next page. |

### `sc_pause_schedule`

Pauses an active schedule so it stops generating new occurrences. Existing occurrences are not affected. Pauses the whole schedule unless site_ids or asset_ids narrow it to sub-schedules (one of the two, matching the schedule's target type).

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `schedule_id` * | string | Schedule ID (from sc_list_schedules). |
| `site_ids` | string[] | Pause only these sites' sub-schedules. |
| `asset_ids` | string[] | Pause only these assets' sub-schedules. |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_resume_schedule`

Resumes a paused schedule so it starts generating new occurrences again. Resumes the whole schedule unless site_ids or asset_ids narrow it to sub-schedules (one of the two, matching the schedule's target type). Ended schedules cannot be resumed.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `schedule_id` * | string | Schedule ID (from sc_list_schedules). |
| `site_ids` | string[] | Resume only these sites' sub-schedules. |
| `asset_ids` | string[] | Resume only these assets' sub-schedules. |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_end_schedule`

Ends an active or paused schedule so it stops generating new occurrences. Existing occurrences are not affected. This cannot be undone: ended schedules cannot be reactivated. Pause instead for a temporary stop.

Access: **destructive** (two-step)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `schedule_id` * | string | Schedule ID (from sc_list_schedules). |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

Without a leaderboard ID, lists the organisation's individual leaderboards. With one, returns its rankings: rank, participant and score.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `leaderboard_id` | string | Leaderboard ID (omit to list leaderboards). |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 50, max 1000). |

### `sc_assign_course`

Updates who a training course is assigned to: assign or unassign users, groups and sites, grant universal access, or clear all assignments of a type. PUT-style: repeating the same call is safe.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `course_id` * | string | Course ID (from sc_list_courses). |
| `assign` | object[] | Individual assignment changes. Find users with sc_search_users, groups with sc_list_groups, sites with sc_list_sites. |
| `universal_access` | boolean | Assign the course to every training user in the organisation. |
| `clear_users` | boolean | Remove all user assignments. |
| `clear_groups` | boolean | Remove all group assignments. |
| `clear_sites` | boolean | Remove all site assignments. |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

## webhooks

Webhooks: list, create and delete event subscriptions

| Tool | Access | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`sc_list_webhooks`](#sc_list_webhooks) | read | List webhooks |
| [`sc_create_webhook`](#sc_create_webhook) | **write** | Create webhook |
| [`sc_delete_webhook`](#sc_delete_webhook) | **destructive** (two-step) | Delete webhook |

### `sc_list_webhooks`

Lists the organisation's webhooks with destination URL, trigger events and enabled state. Never returns the webhook signing key.

Access: read

_No parameters._

### `sc_create_webhook`

Registers a webhook that POSTs to an https URL when any of the given trigger events fire (e.g. TRIGGER_EVENT_INSPECTION_COMPLETED, TRIGGER_EVENT_ACTION_CREATED). Returns the new webhook's ID.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `url` * | string | Destination URL. Must start with https://. |
| `trigger_events` * | enum[] | Events that fire the webhook. Use sc_list_webhooks to see which are already covered. |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

### `sc_delete_webhook`

Permanently deletes one webhook by ID, stopping all its event deliveries. This cannot be undone from the API.

Access: **destructive** (two-step)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `webhook_id` * | string | Webhook ID, from sc_list_webhooks. |
| `reason` | string | Why this change is being made. Stored in the local audit log. |

## feeds

Raw Data Feeds and bulk export to CSV / JSONL

| Tool | Access | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`sc_list_feeds`](#sc_list_feeds) | read | List data feeds |
| [`sc_read_feed`](#sc_read_feed) | read | Read one page of a feed |
| [`sc_sync`](#sc_sync) ★ | read | Sync the local cache |
| [`sc_sync_status`](#sc_sync_status) ★ | read | Cache sync status |
| [`sc_export_dataset`](#sc_export_dataset) ★ | read | Export a cached feed to CSV / JSONL |
| [`sc_query_cache`](#sc_query_cache) | read | SQL over the local cache |

### `sc_list_feeds`

Lists the Data Feeds this server can mirror into its local cache: what each contains, whether it syncs incrementally, how many rows are cached and how fresh they are.

Access: read

_No parameters._

### `sc_read_feed`

Fetches one page of raw rows straight from a live Data Feed (not the cache), optionally only rows modified after a time. Use it to inspect field names or recent changes; use sc_sync + sc_query_cache for whole data sets.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `feed` * | `inspections` \| `inspection_items` \| `templates` \| `sites` \| `users` \| `groups` \| `group_users` \| `site_members` \| `actions` \| `action_assignees` \| `action_timeline_items` \| `issues` \| `issue_timeline_items` \| `schedules` \| `schedule_assignees` \| `schedule_occurrences` \| `assets` \| `activity_log_events` \| `credentials` \| `credential_types` \| `contractor_companies` \| `training_course_progress` \| `investigations` | Feed to read (see sc_list_feeds). |
| `modified_after` | string | Only rows modified after this time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Only for feeds that sync incrementally. |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 20, max 200). |
| `page_token` | string | next_page_token from a previous call, to read the following page. |

### `sc_sync` ★

Pulls Data Feeds into the local analytics cache (only the local cache file is written; nothing changes in Mitti). Incremental by default; full re-pulls everything. Returns per-feed rows fetched, completeness and errors.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `feeds` | enum[] | Feeds to sync. Default: inspections, inspection_items, actions, issues, sites, users, templates, schedules, schedule_occurrences. |
| `full` | boolean | Ignore the saved watermark and re-pull each feed from the start (default false). |
| `max_rows` | integer | Row cap per feed (default 50000). A capped feed is reported as complete: false. |

### `sc_sync_status` ★

Shows, per feed, how many rows are in the local cache, when it was last synced, whether the sync was complete, and any error; plus the cache file path and size.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `feeds` | enum[] | Limit to these feeds (default: all). |

### `sc_export_dataset` ★

Writes a cached feed, or a filtered subset (period on a date field, sites, templates), to a CSV or JSONL file in the export folder and returns the path, row count and columns. Syncs the feed first if it is older than an hour. Emails/names follow the privacy level (SC_PII).

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `feed` * | `inspections` \| `inspection_items` \| `templates` \| `sites` \| `users` \| `groups` \| `group_users` \| `site_members` \| `actions` \| `action_assignees` \| `action_timeline_items` \| `issues` \| `issue_timeline_items` \| `schedules` \| `schedule_assignees` \| `schedule_occurrences` \| `assets` \| `activity_log_events` \| `credentials` \| `credential_types` \| `contractor_companies` \| `training_course_progress` \| `investigations` | Feed to export (see sc_list_feeds). |
| `format` | `csv` \| `jsonl` | File format (default csv). CSV flattens nested values to JSON text. |
| `period` | string | Only rows whose date_field falls in this window, e.g. "last 90 days", "2026-Q3". Default: all rows. |
| `date_field` | string | Row field the period applies to (default: the feed's modified field, else created_at). Examples: created_at, date_completed, due_time. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `template_ids` | string[] | One or more template IDs. |
| `columns` | string[] | Only these columns, in this order (default: every field). |
| `file_name` | string | File name without folder (default: <feed>-<timestamp>). |

### `sc_query_cache`

Runs one read-only SQL SELECT (SQLite) over the local cache for ad-hoc analysis. Tables: feed_<name>(id, modified_at, data) where data is the raw row as JSON, e.g. SELECT json_extract(data,'$.site_id') AS site, COUNT(*) FROM feed_inspections GROUP BY 1. Max 500 rows, 10 s. Run sc_sync first.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sql` * | string | A single SELECT or WITH ... SELECT statement. No PRAGMA, ATTACH or writes. |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 500, max 500). |

## analytics

Computed analytics: trends, Pareto, backlog ageing, compliance, league tables, comparisons, anomalies

| Tool | Access | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`sc_safety_pulse`](#sc_safety_pulse) ★ | read | Safety pulse (this period vs last) |
| [`sc_analyze_failed_items`](#sc_analyze_failed_items) ★ | read | Failed items Pareto |
| [`sc_analyze_action_backlog`](#sc_analyze_action_backlog) ★ | read | Action backlog ageing |
| [`sc_analyze_schedule_compliance`](#sc_analyze_schedule_compliance) ★ | read | Scheduled inspection compliance |
| [`sc_analyze_credential_radar`](#sc_analyze_credential_radar) ★ | read | Credential expiry radar |
| [`sc_analyze_site_league`](#sc_analyze_site_league) | read | Site league table |
| [`sc_analyze_compare`](#sc_analyze_compare) | read | Compare periods or sites (significance-tested) |
| [`sc_analyze_inspection_trend`](#sc_analyze_inspection_trend) | read | Inspection trend over time |
| [`sc_analyze_template_quality`](#sc_analyze_template_quality) | read | Template question quality |
| [`sc_analyze_inspector_activity`](#sc_analyze_inspector_activity) | read | Inspector activity |
| [`sc_analyze_inspection_anomalies`](#sc_analyze_inspection_anomalies) | read | Inspection patterns worth a second look |
| [`sc_analyze_action_stalls`](#sc_analyze_action_stalls) | read | Where actions stall |
| [`sc_analyze_issue_hotspots`](#sc_analyze_issue_hotspots) | read | Issue hotspots |

### `sc_safety_pulse` ★

Weekly-style safety pulse: inspections completed, average score, failed-item rate, new issues, actions created vs completed, open overdue actions and missed scheduled inspections, each against the previous equal period, plus the top three items needing attention with links.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 7 days. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |

### `sc_analyze_failed_items` ★

Ranks failed inspection items (Pareto) by question, template, site or inspector, optionally matching text in the question or answer (use | for alternatives, e.g. "leak|spill"). Returns failed count, share, cumulative share, failure rate and example inspections.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | Text to find in the item label or response, case-insensitive; "\|" separates alternatives. |
| `template_ids` | string[] | One or more template IDs. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 90 days. |
| `group_by` | `item` \| `template` \| `site` \| `inspector` | How to group failures. Default: item (question label within a template). |
| `top` | integer | Number of groups to return (default 20). |

### `sc_analyze_action_backlog` ★

Open corrective actions by age and days overdue (0-7 / 8-30 / 31-90 / 90+), open with no due date, median and p90 resolution time, opened vs closed per week and the 10 oldest open actions, grouped by site, assignee, priority or label.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `priority` | enum[] | Only these priorities. |
| `group_by` | `site` \| `assignee` \| `priority` \| `label` | Grouping for the table. Default: site. |
| `overdue_only` | boolean | Only count open actions that are past due. |
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 90 days. |

### `sc_analyze_schedule_compliance` ★

Scheduled inspections due in a period: completed on time, late, missed and still pending, with compliance % (on time / resolved), grouped by schedule, site, assignee or template, and the 10 worst groups.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 30 days. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `template_ids` | string[] | One or more template IDs. |
| `group_by` | `schedule` \| `site` \| `assignee` \| `template` | Grouping for the table. Default: schedule. |

### `sc_analyze_credential_radar` ★

Licences and credentials that are expired or expire within 7, 30 or 90 days (up to the horizon), grouped by person and by credential type. Use before shutdowns, audits or contractor onboarding.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `horizon` | string | How far ahead to look, e.g. "next 30 days", "next 90 days" or "2026-10-01..2026-12-31". Default: next 30 days. |
| `credential_types` | string[] | Only credential types whose name contains one of these (case-insensitive) or with these type IDs. |
| `include_expired` | boolean | Include already-expired credentials (default true). |

### `sc_analyze_site_league`

Ranks sites on inspections, average score, failed-item rate, open overdue actions and median action resolution days using an equal-weight z-score composite, with rank change vs the previous period. Sites below the minimum inspection count are listed separately.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 90 days. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `min_inspections` | integer | Minimum completed inspections for a site to be ranked (default 10). |
| `metrics` | enum[] | Metrics in the composite (default: all five). |

### `sc_analyze_compare`

Compares two periods, or two groups of sites, on failed-item rate (two-proportion test), average inspection score and action resolution time (Mann-Whitney), with a verdict per measure ("real difference", "probably noise", "not enough data"), effect sizes and a plain-English explanation.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `periods` \| `sites` | periods: period_a vs period_b. sites: site_ids_a vs site_ids_b over period_a. Default: sites when site groups are given. |
| `period_a` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 30 days (periods) / last 90 days (sites). |
| `period_b` | string | Second period for mode=periods. Default: the equal-length period before period_a. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | mode=periods: restrict both periods to these sites. |
| `site_ids_a` | string[] | mode=sites: first site group. |
| `site_ids_b` | string[] | mode=sites: second site group. |

### `sc_analyze_inspection_trend`

Weekly or monthly series for one metric (inspections completed, average score, failed-item rate, issues, actions created or completed) with the count behind each value, the same bucket last year when cached, and a linear trend direction (stated only with 6+ buckets).

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `metric` * | `inspections_completed` \| `average_score` \| `failed_item_rate` \| `issues_created` \| `actions_created` \| `actions_completed` | What to chart. |
| `grain` | `week` \| `month` | Bucket size (default month). |
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 6 months. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `template_ids` | string[] | One or more template IDs. |

### `sc_analyze_template_quality`

Per-question hygiene for one template: times answered, fail rate, N/A rate, skip rate, average free-text length, sorted into cut candidate / fix / keep with the evidence. Also the median inspection duration and duplicate labels. Use to tidy templates.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `template_id` * | string | Template ID (template_...). Use sc_list_templates to find it. |
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 6 months. |

### `sc_analyze_inspector_activity`

Per inspector (inspection owner): inspections completed, median duration, failed-item detection rate against the organisation's rate on the same templates, and the share of very fast inspections. Descriptive, not a performance score.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 30 days. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `template_ids` | string[] | One or more template IDs. |

### `sc_analyze_inspection_anomalies`

Flags inspections matching a review pattern: too fast for the template, a long perfect-score streak on a template that usually fails items, a burst of duplicates within 5 minutes, or a score far outside the template's norm. Each flag carries its reason and numbers. Prompts for review, not findings.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `too_fast` \| `perfect_streak` \| `duplicate_burst` \| `score_outlier` | Pattern to check. Default: all four. |
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 30 days. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `template_ids` | string[] | One or more template IDs. |

### `sc_analyze_action_stalls`

Replays action timelines: time spent in each status, the longest stretch without activity, due-date changes and reassignments per action, and which status holds most of the open time. Select by action IDs or by site, priority and creation period.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `action_ids` | string[] | Specific action IDs (UUIDs); combined with any other filters given. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `priority` | enum[] | Only these priorities. |
| `period` | string | Only actions created in this window, e.g. "last 90 days", "2026-Q3". Default: all cached actions. |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 50, max 500). |

### `sc_analyze_issue_hotspots`

Issues by category and site, with a rate per 100 completed inspections at that site, the top hotspots and the categories rising against the previous period (10+ issues).

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 90 days. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |
| `limit` | integer | Max records to return (default 25, max 200). |

| [`sc_report_site_scorecard`](#sc_report_site_scorecard) | read | Site scorecard report |

### `sc_report_safety_pulse`

Writes a one-page safety pulse (HTML and Markdown) to the local export folder: KPI tiles with changes, a 12-week inspection chart, top failed items, overdue actions and an attention list. Returns the file paths and headline numbers.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 7 days. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |

### `sc_report_audit_pack`

Writes an audit or regulator evidence pack (HTML and Markdown) for a set of sites and period: inspection volume and score trend, failed-item Pareto, action backlog and closure, issues by category, schedule compliance when data exists, and a data coverage appendix.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 12 months. |
| `site_ids` | string[] | One or more site IDs to filter by. |

### `sc_report_site_scorecard`

Writes a scorecard for one site (HTML and Markdown): KPI tiles, monthly trend, top failed items, open actions, issues by category and an inspector activity summary.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `site_id` * | string | Site ID. Use sc_list_sites to find it. |
| `period` | string | Time window, e.g. "last 30 days", "last quarter", "2026-Q3", "2026-07", "2026-07-01..2026-09-30", "ytd". Default: last 6 months. |

## integrations

Exports for Power BI / Qlik / Excel, Slack and Teams notifications

| Tool | Access | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`sc_export_bi_bundle`](#sc_export_bi_bundle) | read | Export a BI bundle (Power BI / Qlik / Excel) |
| [`sc_post_to_chat`](#sc_post_to_chat) | **write** | Post to Slack or Teams |

### `sc_export_bi_bundle`

Writes a folder with a star schema as CSV (inspections, inspection items, actions, issues, schedule occurrences, sites, templates, users, dates), a manifest, a Power Query M script, a Qlik load script and a README. Uses the local cache (synced first if older than an hour); only local files are written.

Access: read

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `period` | string | Only facts dated in this window, e.g. "last 12 months", "2026". Dimensions are always complete. Default: everything cached. |
| `folder_name` | string | Folder name inside the export folder (default: bi-bundle-<timestamp>). |

### `sc_post_to_chat`

Posts a short Markdown message to a Slack or Microsoft Teams channel through an incoming webhook that the server operator configured by name (SC_NOTIFY_WEBHOOKS). Call without a valid name to see the configured names.

Access: **write**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `webhook` * | string | Name of a configured webhook (from SC_NOTIFY_WEBHOOKS), not a URL. |
| `message` * | string | Markdown message, max 3000 characters. |
| `reason` | string | Why this message is being sent. Stored in the local audit log. |
